It is reminiscent of the concept of 'Nur Muhammad', the light of Muhammad, the Prophet of Islam, who is believed to have brought guidance to the world. This name reflects the importance of knowledge, faith, and wisdom in Islamic society.

It is believed that every person possesses an inner light or 'Nur' of faith, which is nurtured through good deeds, prayer, and worship. By bestowing the name Nurat upon a child, parents are reminding them of their spiritual duties and responsibilities as Muslims, encouraging them to seek knowledge, act with wisdom, and preserve their faith through challenging times.
